business_rules.title: Order Revenue and Financial Reconciliation
business_rules.content: An order's total_amount is strictly calculated as: subtotal_amount - discount_amount + shipping_amount + tax_amount. When calculating gross sales revenue across orders, sum orders.total_amount for orders where status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') and status != 'cancelled'. For line-item analytics, order_items.total_price equals (unit_price * quantity) - discount_amount.

business_rules.title: Membership Tiers and Loyalty Rewards
business_rules.content: Customers are categorized into 4 membership tiers: Standard (0-499 pts), Silver (500-1199 pts), Gold (1200-3499 pts), and Platinum (3500+ pts). Lifetime spend and order counts are tracked in customer_profiles and updated upon successful order completion.

business_rules.title: Inventory Availability and Stock Movement Audit
business_rules.content: Inventory items track quantity_on_hand and quantity_reserved across multiple regional warehouses. The virtual column is_available indicates whether (quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved) > 0. Low stock alerts are triggered when quantity_on_hand <= safety_threshold. Every adjustment is recorded in stock_movements.

business_rules.title: Coupon Types and Usage Limits
business_rules.content: Coupons support three discount types: 'percentage', 'fixed_amount', and 'free_shipping'. Coupons enforce minimum_order_amount, optional max_discount_amount caps, and usage_limit_per_user. Total redemptions are audited in coupon_redemptions and reflected in coupons.times_used via triggers.

business_rules.title: Verified Reviews and Star Ratings
business_rules.content: Product reviews have rating values from 1 to 5. Verified reviews (is_verified_purchase = 1) are linked via foreign keys to the customer's actual order and order_item. Helpful votes are recorded in review_helpful_votes and aggregated into helpful_votes.

business_rules.title: Returns RMA and Refund Settlements
business_rules.content: Return requests (RMAs) are created for delivered orders with reasons such as defective, sizing, or changed preference. Upon inspection and restocking approval in return_items, refunds are processed against the original payment_id and linked to the order.
